otherness: The quality of being different or distinct.
otherwhere: Synonym of somewhere else: elsewhere, in or to some other place.
otherwhile: At other times; on other occasions.
otherwhiles: At another time, or other times.
otherworld: A world beyond death; an afterlife.
otherworldly: Of, concerned with, or preoccupied with a world different from the tangible world, especially a fantasy, imaginary, or mystical world.
otic: Of, relating/pertaining to, or located near the ear.
otiosity: The state or quality of being otiose.
otitic: Relating to otitis, or inflammation of the ear.
otocyst: An organ involved in balance and orientation.
otolaryngology: The study of diseases of the ear, nose and throat.
otolith: A small particle, composed mainly of calcium carbonate, found in the inner ear of vertebrates, being part of the balance sense.
otolithic: Of or pertaining to an otolith.
otology: The branch of medicine that deals with the ear, its structure, function and pathology.
otorhinolaryngologist: A doctor specializing in otorhinolaryngology, the study of the ear, nose, and throat.
otosclerosis: Sclerosis of the tissues of the labyrinth and middle ear.
otoscope: An instrument used for examining the eardrum and interior of the outer ear.
otoscopy: The visual examination of the inner ear using an otoscope
ototoxicity: Damage to the ear, specifically the cochlea and sometimes the vestibular system, by a toxin.
ottava: One octave higher; as a marking, typically abbreviated 8va.
otter: An aquatic or marine carnivorous mammal in the subfamily Lutrinae.
ottoman: An upholstered sofa, without arms or a back, sometimes with a compartment for storing linen etc.
